> Aditya —
> 
> Thanks for the initial sizing estimate you sent last week. Attached is our current SLO/traffic profile...

Sam / Priya —

Thanks for the SLO doc. Quick summary of how Redwood proposes to validate before flipping routing to dedicated:

1) Rightsize verification (lab): run 72-hour stress runs with production-like request distribution to validate sustained throughput and p95 latency.
2) Staging replay: Redwood will replay a sampled subset of EdgeScale traffic (obfuscated) against a dedicated pool in our staging region. We recommend a 48-hour run.
3) Cutover rehearsals: two weekend rehearsals — a smoke rehearsal (read-only load) and a full failover rehearsal where we shift 20% traffic for 2 hours then 100% for a controlled 30-minute window.

Proposed dates (all UTC-8):
- Staging run: 2026-11-14 → 2026-11-15 (48 hours)
- Smoke rehearsal: 2026-11-21 (Saturday morning window)
- Full cutover rehearsal: 2026-11-28 (Saturday)
- Final cutover: 2026-12-04 (Saturday)

I've attached a compact sizing matrix that shows the reserved GPU pool, expected qps, and buffer headroom per shard (proposed-sizing-matrix.csv).

Can Karthik and Dev confirm the test plan and whether the staging replay requires any special telemetry hooks from EdgeScale? Also need procurement signoff window to ensure capacity reservation starts on 2026-12-01.

- Aditya
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed-sizing-matrix.csv

—Sam

Aditya / team —

Operational checklist and technical notes for the staging replay and rehearsals:

- Telemetry: Redwood needs sampling telemetry (trace_id + latency buckets + token count) at 1% sampling from your prod export. If you cannot share traces we can validate with synthetic traffic.
- KV cache warmup: we will run a pre-warm job 6 hours before the replay to populate common prefixes; expected warmup network egress ~120GB.
- GPU pool: proposed 12xA10s per shard (4 shards) to meet p95 < 120ms at 10k concurrent sessions — includes 25% headroom for bursts.
- Fallback policy: during rehearsals we will keep hosted fallback enabled; traffic will be routed back automatically if tail latency exceeds 300ms for >5 minutes.
- Runbook attachment: staging-runbook.md (contains rollback triggers, Prometheus alerts, and post-mortem template).

We will not require a schema change or SDK freeze. All requests remain compatible. The staging replay will be read-only replayed requests and should not result in customer-visible downtime if routed to a staging alias.

Dev Patel
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: staging-runbook.md
